trial_court: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-cum-II Additional District Judge, Kurnool (O.P. No. 160 of 1993)
case_name: United India Insurance Company Limited vs Eda Anjanamma And Ors.
facts_of_case: E. Venkata Ramana died in a tractor accident. His wife, father, and mother filed an application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act claiming compensation. The Tribunal awarded Rs. 94,400/- to the claimants. The insurance company appealed against the order.

legal_principles.principle: A widow's right to claim compensation must be confined to those who are entitled to be maintained and supported by the victim as his legal representatives.
legal_principles.held: The Division Bench held that the right to claim compensation must he confined to those who are entitled to be maintained and supported by the victim as his legal representatives.
cited_cases: State of Orissa v. Archana Nayak, (1987) ACJ 772 (Orissa) (DB)

legal_principles.principle: A widow ceases to be a legal representative of her first husband upon her remarriage.
legal_principles.held: The Bench further observed that the widow ceases to be a legal representative for the purpose of Section 110-A upon her remarriage.
cited_cases: State of Orissa v. Archana Nayak, (1987) ACJ 772 (Orissa) (DB)

legal_principles.principle: A widow's dependency ends upon her remarriage.
legal_principles.held: Under Section 22 of the Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act, 1956, she also ceases to be a dependant and thus if a widow remarries after the death of her husband, her dependency ends.

use_for_drafting: arguing a compensation claim in a motor vehicle accident case
